name: Čadca (Slovakia)
description: Quartered white and green, white in the upper hoist and lower fly, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature C-1/1991.
